references.text: Kirjath-jearim is mentioned as a city in Judah and provides geographical context for where the Danites camped.
Kirjath-jearim is listed as one of the cities of the tribe of Judah, confirming the location mentioned in Judges 18:12.
Kirjath-jearim is the place where the ark of the covenant was kept, highlighting the city's significance in Israel's history.
David brought the ark of the covenant from Kirjath-jearim, confirming the city's important role in Israel's religious history.
The Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson at Mahane-dan, the same place that got its name from the Danite camp described in this text.
